ownership.quote: Northflank, a startup from a couple of guys in their 20s, has been working on a full-stack DevOps platform in the cloud since their first year at university in 2016.

stage.quote: Today marks a significant milestone for Northflank—we've secured $22 million in Series A and Seed funding, led by Bain Capital Ventures and Vertex Ventures US, with participation from Kindred Ventures, Pebblebed, and Uncorrelated Ventures.
stage.note: The Nov 2024 post bundles a Series A with an additional seed tranche into one $22M announcement; the company's own text calls it 'a successful Series A', so Series A is treated as the last priced round.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of the $2.6M 2020 seed (TechCrunch) + the $22M Series A/seed round announced Nov 2024 (Northflank blog); no aggregator total found to cross-check, and it's unclear whether the $22M figure already nets out the earlier $2.6M seed.
total_funding_usd.quote: we've secured $22 million in Series A and Seed funding

last_round.quote: we've secured $22 million in Series A and Seed funding, led by Bain Capital Ventures and Vertex Ventures US, with participation from Kindred Ventures, Pebblebed, and Uncorrelated Ventures.

note: Founded early 2019 (per Northflank's own Series A blog post) by Will Stewart (CEO) and Frederik Brix (CTO), who met as teens through online gaming and built the platform during university. UK-based developer platform / PaaS with Kubernetes abstraction and BYOC; no evidence of an accelerator/incubator. Customers cited include Sentry and Writer. No revenue or headcount figures were publicly disclosed.
